anomalies.observed: U3 is an LM2576HVS-5 fixed 5V regulator, but its feedback pin (pin 4) is connected to a resistor divider R36=10K (to +5V) and R37=10K (to GND), which would set the output to approximately 2.46V.
anomalies.expected: For a fixed 5V LM2576-5, the FB pin should be connected directly to the output (+5V), not to an external divider.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail will regulate to approximately 2.46V instead of 5V, causing widespread malfunction of downstream circuits.

anomalies.observed: No PCF85063ATAAZ or any RTC device is present in the schematic.
anomalies.expected: The design specification states the board implements an RTC using a PCF85063ATAAZ.

evidence.quote: an RTC (datasheet link in cm4_robot_board/docs points to a PCF85063ATAAZ RTC — see new_notes.txt)

anomalies.impact: The board will lack real-time clock functionality.

anomalies.observed: Reference designator U26 is used for both a PCA9536 I/O expander in the I/O section and a USBLC6-2P6 USB ESD protection device in the USB section.
anomalies.expected: Each reference designator must be unique.

evidence.quote: U26 PCA9536 (I/O section); U26 USBLC6-2P6 (USB section)

anomalies.impact: Netlist and assembly files will be ambiguous, potentially causing wrong component placement or connection errors.

parsed.summary: Anomalies detected: duplicate reference designator U26, missing RTC PCF85063ATAAZ, and an incorrect feedback divider on U3 that would set the 5V rail to ~2.46V instead of 5V.
